# ZB Automations

> ZB Automations builds websites and AI automation for Irish small businesses — designed, built, and looked after end to end by one operator based in Kildare, Ireland.

## Important context

ZB Automations is a one-person agency, not a software product with a signup flow. Services (websites, AI automation) are scoped per client through a direct conversation — there is no public price list, no self-serve checkout, and no account to create on zbautomations.ie. Contact is via WhatsApp, email, or phone — see Contact below.

## Services

- Websites: design, build, copy, domain, and hosting, delivered as one link that works properly on a phone and is built to bring in enquiries — not a generic template.
- AI automation: missed-call text-back, booking and reminder flows, review requests, quote follow-ups, invoice chasing, and inbox triage — the repetitive admin work handled automatically.
- Delivery: one person handles the whole job, from the first conversation through launch and any changes afterward — no account managers or handoffs.
- Coverage: based in Kildare, working with businesses across all of Ireland, remote-friendly.

## Product

### Matrix (AI command center)
Matrix is the self-hosted AI platform ZB Automations built for its own workflow, and the reason delivery is fast. It is not sold or hosted for clients — see /matrix.html for details.
- Multi-provider AI chat across 20+ models, autonomous agents with 59 GitHub tools plus Slack/Gmail/Drive/Calendar, an FTS5-backed memory bank, a deep research engine, a full on-disk IDE, and an integrated AI site builder (Matrix Builder).
